interpretation.current_physical_invariants: Conclude no observed violation only for invariant checks whose actual receipt replay passes and the two explicitly zero native diagnostic counters. Reject/expiry/quarantine events remain separately counted.
interpretation.batch_and_prefix: All original streamed initial batches checked. Same native/controller/public activation prefix supports common warmup. Residual native observations are refreshed in frozen foundation_airport_protocol_v2 after every pending submission; they are not individually persisted in this initial callback stream.
interpretation.quarantine: C01 seed17 and seed29 each have one real empty-leg failure before physical entry. Native released unused receiver reservation and quarantined the physical tray. This is protective expiry enforcement with actual availability loss; it is neither a successful transfer nor evidence of an illegal physical entry. Both failed payloads are observed_source_queue rule allocations, so their individual causal effect cannot be attributed to a learned patch from these saved full-policy runs.
interpretation.rejections: receiving_full, receiver_transit_reserve and departure_lease_expired are documented native admission/lease refusals. Their existence does not establish physical capacity violation, and zero actual violation does not imply absence of performance harm.
interpretation.G2: No protected takeover or full G2 conclusion follows. Shared loaded/empty channel interference, future FIFO/route impacts and all unfinished job completion times remain uncertified; observed known harms must be retained.
interpretation.compute_cost_units: J is physical unfinished-bag integral in bag-seconds. Synchronous callback planning/audit wall time pauses the simulated physical clock. Saved wall milliseconds cannot be subtracted directly from J and have no validated asynchronous deployment latency mapping. Positive J advantage does not by itself prove benefit exceeds decision cost or real-time/SLA feasibility.

limits: This is the seven explicitly released P901 branches only; no other D/G outputs were opened.
The pure audit_result receipt checker was extracted unchanged from pinned native_host source; it was not a native replay or a proof of every owner-internal invariant.
Initial callback hash chains were fully checked locally here, while the lightweight review ZIP may omit those raw streams and cannot claim the recipient has repeated this full stream audit.
Source inspection establishes residual refresh control flow; individual residual observation snapshots were not reconstructed.
No model rescore, training, strategy selection or tuning was performed.
